description: This file defines an I18nController class for managing reactive internationalization updates in a Lit-based web component, subscribing to an i18n service and triggering updates on connection events.

classes.name: I18nController
classes.description: A reactive controller that integrates internationalization updates into a Lit component.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the controller with a host and registers it.

methods.name: hostConnected
methods.description: Subscribes to the i18n service and requests an update when connected.

methods.name: hostDisconnected
methods.description: Unsubscribes from the i18n service when disconnected.
